# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)

library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(CellChat)
library(UCell)
```



# Load data

```{r, include=FALSE}
load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/sc_combined_subclusters.RData")
```



# Subset scRNAseq for LLC tumour-bearing muscle

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(all_genes, Agca_snLLC_CTL, Agca_snLLC_LLC, Brown_scLLC_CTL, Brown_scLLC_2w, Brown_scLLC_2.5w, Brown_scLLC_3.5w, Kim_scB16F10_CTL, Kim_scB16F10_B16F10, Pryce_scC26_CTL, Pryce_scC26_C26, Pryce_scKPP_CTL, Pryce_scKPP_KPP, Zhang_snKIC_CTL, Zhang_snKIC_KIC, DEGs_sc_combined)

Idents(sc_combined) <- "experiment"

LLC_model <- subset(sc_combined, idents = c("Agca_snLLC", "Brown_scLLC"))

rm(sc_combined)
```



# Read in the list of receptors that match ligands from bulkRNAseq of LLC tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_receptors <- read.csv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/tumour_bulk_RNAseq/receptor_lists/LLC_secreted_genes_receptors.csv", header = FALSE)

LLC_receptors <- LLC_receptors[[1]]
```


## Check to see which genes are not present in LLC_model and remove from LLC_receptors

```{r}
LLC_receptors_use <- intersect(LLC_receptors, rownames(LLC_model))

not_in_model <- setdiff(LLC_receptors, rownames(LLC_model))

not_in_model

rm(not_in_model, LLC_receptors)
```



# Run GO terms on all receptors picking up signals from tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_model_go <- enrichGO(gene = LLC_receptors_use, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(LLC_model_go, file = "go_LLC_receptors_use.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```


## Visualize top 10 GO terms

```{r}
LLC_model_go_top10 <- LLC_model_go[1:10, ]

ggplot(LLC_model_go_top10, aes(x = FoldEnrichment, 
                           y = reorder(Description, FoldEnrichment),
                           size = Count, 
                           color = p.adjust)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "adj. p-value") +
  labs(x = "Fold Enrichment", y = NULL, 
       title = "UP GO LLC muscle receptors") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )
```



# Run KEGG pathway analysis on the receptors that are upregulated in tumour-bearing muscle

### Get DEGs in tumour-bearing muscle

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(LLC_model) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_LLC_model <- FindMarkers(LLC_model, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_2w", "Brown_scLLC_2.5w", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEG for p_val_adj < 0.05 and avg_log2FC > 0.2 and in LLC_receptors_use

```{r}
DEGs_LLC_model <- subset(DEGs_LLC_model, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_LLC_model <- DEGs_LLC_model[rownames(DEGs_LLC_model) %in% LLC_receptors_use,
]

rownames(DEGs_LLC_model)
```

### KEGG pathway analysis

```{r, include=FALSE}
### Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs
DEGs_LLC_model_gene_names <- rownames(DEGs_LLC_model)

DEGs_LLC_model_IDs <- bitr(DEGs_LLC_model_gene_names,
                  fromType = "SYMBOL",
                  toType   = "ENTREZID",
                  OrgDb    = org.Mm.eg.db)

DEGs_LLC_model_kegg <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = DEGs_LLC_model_IDs$ENTREZID,
  organism     = "mmu",
  keyType      = "kegg",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

write.csv(DEGs_LLC_model_kegg, file = "DEGs_LLC_receptors_use_kegg.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

### Visualize KEGG pathways

```{r}
LLC_signaling_pathways <- c(1, 2)
LLC_kegg_signaling <- DEGs_LLC_model_kegg[LLC_signaling_pathways, ]

LLC_kegg_signaling$Description <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)$", "", LLC_kegg_signaling$Description)

ggplot(LLC_kegg_signaling, aes(x = FoldEnrichment, 
                           y = reorder(Description, FoldEnrichment),
                           size = Count, 
                           color = p.adjust)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "adj. p-value") +
  labs(x = "Fold Enrichment", y = NULL, 
       title = "UP KEGG LLC muscle") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )
```



# Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(DEGs_LLC_model, DEGs_LLC_model_IDs, DEGs_LLC_model_gene_names, DEGs_LLC_model_kegg, kegg_category, LLC_kegg_signaling, LLC_model_go, LLC_model_go_top10, LLC_signaling_pathways)
```



# Score cells for receptor expression

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_receptors_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(LLC_model, features = list(LLC_receptors_use), name = "LLC_receptors_score")

means_LLC_receptors_score <- LLC_receptors_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_LLC_receptors_score = mean(signature_1LLC_receptors_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
print(means_LLC_receptors_score)
```

```{r}
cluster_colours <- c(
    "Satellite cells"      = "#FF7FBF",
    "Myoblasts"            = "#FF3F80",
    "Myonuclei"            = "#E00000",
    "Endothelial cells"    = "#FFFF00",
    "vSMCs"                = "#BC9D00",
    "Pericytes"            = "#8B5A2B",
    "FAPs"                 = "#7CFC00",
    "Tenocytes"            = "#228B22",
    "Platelets"            = "#D46A6A", 
    "Mast cells"           = "#C85C8C", 
    "Dendritic cells"      = "#B84D9E", 
    "Monocytes"            = "#80E5FF",
    "Macrophages"          = "#1E90FF",
    "Neutrophils"          = "#4169E1",
    "B cells"              = "#C9A2FF",
    "T cells"              = "#B44CFF",
    "NK cells"             = "#5B0E8A",
    "Neural/glial cells"   = "#FF7F00",
    "Schwann cells"        = "#FFA64D" 
)

VlnPlot(LLC_receptors_score, features = "signature_1LLC_receptors_score", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colours) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "LLC receptors score", title = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black")
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(
  LLC_receptors_score, features = "signature_1LLC_receptors_score", reduction = "umap") +
  labs(color = "LLC receptors score") +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())
```

# What receptor genes are upregulated in cachectic endothelial cells in the muscle?

### Subset for endothelial cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(LLC_model) <- "seurat_clusters"

LLC_model_ECs <- subset(LLC_model, idents = "Endothelial cells")
```

### DEGs in tumour-bearing endothelial cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(LLC_model_ECs) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_LLC_model_ECs <- FindMarkers(LLC_model_ECs, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_2w", "Brown_scLLC_2.5w", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEGs for p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.2, included in LLC_receptors_use

```{r}
DEGs_LLC_model_ECs_from_tumour <- subset(DEGs_LLC_model_ECs, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_LLC_model_ECs_from_tumour <- DEGs_LLC_model_ECs_from_tumour[
    rownames(DEGs_LLC_model_ECs_from_tumour) %in% LLC_receptors_use,
]

rownames(DEGs_LLC_model_ECs_from_tumour)
```
#### Cd36 - Fatty acid translocase, mediates angiogenesis inhibition and fatty acid metabolism to support tumour cells. 
#### Adgrg1 - Adhesion receptor for cell adhesion, migration, and ECM interactions. Plays a role in vascular integrity and immune cell activation.
#### Flt1 - VEGF receptor, traps VEGF signals to inhibit angiogenesis. 
#### Ackr3 - Atypical chemochine (CXCR7) that mediates chemokine scavenging, cell migration and angiogenesis, promotes endothelial cell survival in tumours.

### Violin plots

```{r}
VlnPlot(LLC_model_ECs, features = "Cd36", pt.size = 0) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Expression", title = "Cd36")

VlnPlot(LLC_model_ECs, features = "Adgrg1", pt.size = 0) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Expression", title = "Adgrg1")

VlnPlot(LLC_model_ECs, features = "Flt1", pt.size = 0) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Expression", title = "Flt1")

VlnPlot(LLC_model_ECs, features = "Ackr3", pt.size = 0) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Expression", title = "Ackr3")
```



# What receptor genes are upregulated in cachectic myeloid cells in the muscle?

### Subset for myeloid cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(LLC_model) <- "seurat_clusters"

LLC_model_myeloid <- subset(LLC_model, idents = c("Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Neutrophils"))
```

### DEGs in tumour-bearing myeloid cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(LLC_model_myeloid) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_LLC_model_myeloid <- FindMarkers(LLC_model_myeloid, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_2w", "Brown_scLLC_2.5w", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEGs for p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.2, included in LLC_receptors_use

```{r}
DEGs_LLC_model_myeloid_from_tumour <- subset(DEGs_LLC_model_myeloid, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_LLC_model_myeloid_from_tumour <- DEGs_LLC_model_myeloid_from_tumour[
    rownames(DEGs_LLC_model_myeloid_from_tumour) %in% LLC_receptors_use,
]

rownames(DEGs_LLC_model_myeloid_from_tumour)
```
#### Tyrobp - Activation signals and cytokine production.
#### Cd44 - Cell adhesion, migration, matrix remodeling. 
#### Il1rap - Inflammation through NF-kB-MAPK.
#### Pirb - Immune tolerance.
#### Cxcr2 - Neutrophil recruitment, angiogenesis, and tumour-promoting inflammation.
#### Sorl1 - Regulates cell signaling.
#### Fpr1 - Roles in sterile inflammation, tumour microenvironment modulation and cell migration.
#### Ccr1 - Recruitment of inflammatory myeloid cells.
#### Plaur - Matrix degredation and cell migration.
#### Itgb2 - Leukocyte adhesion.
#### Fpr2 - Regulates inflammatory response.
#### Adipor1 - Mediates metabolic and anti-inflammatory signalling via AMPK and PPAR pathways.
#### Itga5 - Mediates cell adhesion, migration, mechanotransduction and growth-factor signalling.
